WodeMac · Remote Mac guides

Control a remote Mac mini from your phone, iPad or computer

Reviewed: 2026-11-12 · WodeMac

One remote Mac can be reached from a phone, an iPad and a computer. Phones and iPads open the remote desktop in a browser; computers use the WodeMac Mac App or a browser. When you only want to follow a coding task, Claude Code Remote Control continues the same session on your phone. The task runs on the remote Mac, so changing devices or dropping the connection does not stop it.

What each device is good for

Reaching the same remote Mac from different devices
DeviceHow it connectsGood for

Single-app mode, which brings one remote app window onto your own desktop, is currently Mac only.

Why switching devices does not interrupt work

Builds, tests and agent sessions run on the Mac in California; the device in your hand only shows the picture and passes along input. Closing the phone browser, shutting a laptop or changing Wi-Fi drops that display link and nothing else. Reconnect and you are back at the same desktop with the same windows.

For long jobs, run them in tmux or as a background process with a log file, so the output is there to read from any device even if a remote desktop session was closed.

Continuing a Claude Code session on your phone

Claude Code has Remote Control: start a session on the remote Mac and the same session appears in the Claude mobile app or a browser, where you can read output and keep giving instructions. On a small screen this is easier than driving a whole desktop, and suits the moments when you only need to check progress and approve the next step.

The feature is provided by Anthropic; availability and requirements follow the official documentation, and you need your own eligible Claude account.

Security and practical tips

  • Sign in separately on each device and do not save credentials on shared ones.
  • WodeMac Remote Screen encrypts the picture and input end to end.
  • On a weak mobile connection, prefer Remote Control or a terminal, which use far less data than a full screen.
  • Responsiveness depends on your network path to California; tell us where you are before ordering to confirm the connection method.

FAQ

Can an iPad be my main device for a remote Mac?

You can open the full remote desktop in the browser and, with a keyboard, do light development and reviews comfortably. For long coding sessions a computer is still better; single-app mode is currently Mac only.

Does the task stop if my phone loses signal?

No. The task runs on the remote Mac and the phone is only a window for viewing and input. Reconnecting returns you to the same desktop or session.

Do I need a dedicated app on my phone?

A browser is enough for the remote desktop. For Claude Code Remote Control you can use the Claude mobile app or a browser, as described in Anthropic's documentation.

Can several people connect to one Mac at once?

Each Mac is rented to one customer, and how a team shares it is up to you. For people working in parallel over a long period, one Mac each avoids competing for the desktop.
